audience: Austrian businesses that invoice customers and check bank transactions in Rechnio

useCases.title: Find the invoices that are still open
useCases.text: List the invoices by status, for example sent or paid, and ask which ones are still unpaid. The assistant can add up the open totals.

useCases.title: Find a customer by company, name or email
useCases.text: Search the customers by company, person name or email. Read the customer number and address before you write an invoice.

useCases.title: Draft an invoice for a new or existing customer
useCases.text: Search for the customer first. Create the customer only if it is new, then create a draft invoice from a series. The draft is not sent. You send it from Rechnio.

useCases.title: Show the bank transactions of a quarter by category
useCases.text: List the bank transactions of a booking date range, for example one quarter, in one category such as Einnahmen (income). Each line shows the amount and description.

useCases.title: Review receipts that have no transaction yet
useCases.text: List the receipts that are not assigned to a transaction. Each one shows the date, amount, counterparty and description read by OCR. Compare them with the bank transactions.
